answer.explanation: From 00:50:48 to 01:00:43 every CompressionFunction invocation (about 408 ERROR lines) failed on s3:PutObject with NoSuchBucket. The handler writes to Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET, so the bucket name it resolves does not exist. The other three functions show no errors, and NoSuchBucket is not an IAM denial. An earlier, separate incident on 2026-10-22 between 22:02 and 22:16 was AccessDenied on s3:PutObject for the role CompressionRole-tNi3wsTWkCVs against lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi. That was outside this window and ended at 22:16. Logs show the intended bucket name but not the live environment variable value, so the exact misconfiguration was inferred from the error rather than read from the function configuration. I could not read the Lambda configuration or the IaC template with the available tools, so the CONFIG attribution is an inference.
